data.name: Roof Replacement
data.description: Full or partial roof replacement by structure.
data.details: Includes tear-off and replacement work, material deliveries, crew scheduling, payments, and closeout.

groups.label: Assignments
groups.description: People and teams responsible for this project.

fields.label: Estimator
fields.description: Salesperson responsible for estimating and selling the project.

fields.label: Inside salesperson
fields.description: Person who scheduled or qualified the sales appointment.

fields.label: Project manager
fields.description: Person responsible for this project's production workflow.

fields.label: Production team
fields.description: Crew, subcontractor, or person assigned to the first production event.

checklists.title: Safety checklist
checklists.description: Site safety items the crew confirms before and during work.

items.title: Ladders set, footed, and tied off
Harnesses and fall protection in use on the roof
Ground drop zones flagged and clear
Power lines identified and kept clear
Landscaping, AC units, and driveway protected

checklists.title: Work checklist
checklists.description: Production items the crew completes during the job.

checklists.title: Completion checklist
checklists.description: Supervisor quality review after the crew finishes.

onCompleted.explainer: When the deposit is paid, the whole team gets a celebration announcement.

list.title: New Customers
list.description: Signed customers whose welcome call is ready.

onReady.explainer: Newly signed customers are added to the Welcome Call queue so the office kicks off the relationship.

children.title: Share project schedule with customer
children.description: Review the scheduled material deliveries and project work, then share the project schedule with the customer.

input.title: Confirm materials were fully delivered
input.message: Walk the delivery and confirm everything on the material list arrived undamaged.

onCompleted.explainer: When materials are delivered, the crew gets a to-do to confirm the delivery arrived complete and undamaged.

input.title: Complete the safety checklist
input.message: Work through the site safety checklist before production starts.

input.title: Complete the work and check off the work checklist
input.message: Finish the scoped work and mark each item on the work checklist.

input.title: Collect the final payment
input.message: Complete the final walkthrough checklist and collect the remaining balance.

input.title: Verify the shingle delivery was fully received
input.message: Check the shingle delivery against the material list before installation.
